summary_1line: Savitri follows Yama after Satyavan’s death, wins multiple boons through wisdom and devotion, and ultimately secures Satyavan’s life.

image_candidates.scene_text: Satyavan collapses in the forest with his head resting on Savitri’s lap as the dark, radiant Yama appears holding a noose.
Yama draws a thumb-sized luminous soul from Satyavan’s body and binds it with a noose while Savitri watches in grief.
Savitri walks behind Yama through the shadowy forest path as he carries Satyavan’s bound soul toward the southern realm.
